findings.asked: Draw a reciprocal graph from a table.
findings.wentWrong: Many drew a straight line; others plotted correctly but ignored the point at (0.5, 12) and started at (1, 6), so the curve did not extend far enough.
findings.rule: A reciprocal graph is a curve that steepens near the axis; include every point.

findings.asked: Sketch a reciprocal-type graph and interpret it.
findings.wentWrong: Most scored some marks, but only the best drew an acceptable part to the left of (1, 6) - many joined to the y-axis or left it blank.
findings.rule: The curve approaches the axes but never touches them.

findings.asked: Match four equations to their graphs.
findings.wentWrong: Nearly all matched some; over a third matched all four.
findings.rule: Know the shapes: line, U or n parabola, S-shaped cubic, two-branch reciprocal.

ruleToRemember: Recognise the four shapes; a reciprocal graph has two branches that approach but never touch the axes, so extend the curve beyond the first and last plotted points.
